text:
devon: quick postmortem follow-up: we saw the regional routing flap last night, root cause traced to stale bgp route injection during autoscale. collecting remediation owners + timeline here. please react with :eyes: if you own an item.

maria: adding backup/runbook items i can take lead on for EU region backups and restore steps. will draft runbook PR by EOD tomorrow. :+1:

samir: i'll own routing rollback gating and can add a simulated BGP failover test to our game-day checklist. propose 2-week cadence for repeats.
jia: logging an observation — recurring pattern: autoscale + deploy window overlaps increase probability. suggest deploy freeze during peak autoscale windows.
leo: ops note: created a short checklist in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/restore — added a section "validate routes before scale". needs SME review.
devon: summary of owners so far: maria -> backups/runbook PR; samir -> routing rollback gating + game-day test; jia -> deploy freeze policy proposal; leo -> runbook updates review. i'll take overall remediation tracker and follow-ups.
sre-bot: incident#INC-2026 created followup tickets: RFC-3182 (deploy freeze), RK-442 (route validation tests), BU-99 (backup restore drill).
maria: draft checklist snippet i'll add to PR: ```restore steps v2
1) snapshot verify
2) bring up db read-only
3) inject test traffic to edge
4) validate KV cache rebuild
```
samir: for the game-day I propose a dry-run routing exercise: 
- simulate regional failure (ctrl-plane isolated)
- verify traffic shifts within 45s
- validate fallback model variants in us-west

can we schedule a 2-hour window next Wed 09:00 PT?
jia: noted pattern: last 3 events had >1 config change during scale window. i'll prepare a small dashboard query to show overlap counts and alert when overlap >0.5 on a 1h window.
leo: backup ownership note: will add post-restore validation step to backup playbook (hash compare + sample query). tagging maria for review.
devon: timeline proposals: runbook PR by maria (tomorrow EOD) -> reviewers leo + devon (48h) -> routing test by samir in 2 weeks -> deploy-freeze RFC by jia in 4 days -> schedule game-day after routing test passes. any objections?
maria: fine with timeline, will include checklist and quick rollback commands in PR, e.g.: ```# rollback routing
kubectl apply -f stable-route.yaml -n infra
sleep 10
kubectl rollout restart deployment/router -n infra
```
samir: thumbs up. I also want to add an automated smoke check that hits our health endpoints after route flip. I'll own the smoke script.
jia: i'll add the dashboard query and a short runbook trigger to notify SRE on overlap >0.5.
devon: items left open: (1) who runs the first restore drill? (2) exact game-day date after routing test. volunteers?
maria: i'll run the first restore drill in EU staging, invite ops and platform.
samir: i'll coordinate game-day date around the routing test; provisional next Wed is ok for me.
leo: i'll review maria's PR ASAP and add the hash-compare snippet.
devon: great — i'll create the remediation tracker doc and assign the tickets from SRE-bot to owners with deadlines. i'll post a one-pager summary to #incidents and ping all of you when done. thanks all. :rotating_light:
